plans.title: The canvas — a command palette over a window canvas
plans.summary: Replaces the removed terminal surface with a browser one — a command palette over draggable windows, where a pinned window re-runs itself on a Python-side cadence, and a right-click menu that takes what is on screen out of it.

plans.title: Highlight — lexical tint for followed lines
plans.summary: Tints a followed line by shape rather than by severity, and lets the operator declare their own vocabulary without repainting sky.boss's. Round 8 is open — the sample that makes such a declaration writable against what a log actually contains.
